notes.title: Block N Load 2 Has Been Cancelled
notes.notes: [p][b]To our valued Block N Load 2 players,[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]We’re writing today to inform you that development on [b]Block N Load 2[/b] has officially been cancelled. [/p][p]The game will be removed from Steam Store on [b]August 1, 2025[/b]. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Account & Data[/b] [/p][list][*][p]As part of the delisting process, and effective immediately, we will begin securely deleting any player data collected in compliance with [b]GDPR[/b], [b]CPRA[/b], and [b]other applicable privacy laws[/b]. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Thank You[/b] [/p][p]To everyone who placed their trust in us: thank you. Whether you played the original [i]Block N Load[/i], participated in playtests, or simply followed along — we appreciate you. [/p][p][/p][p]Sincerely, [/p][p][b]The Block N Load 2 Team[/b] [/p]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508564/2809216e85abe37de4e7a2c3bbb64d428c5db25c.jpg[/img]
Greetings Blockheads
A quick update regarding Beta Testing and release.
We will be postponing the next phase of Beta Testing until later next year, which obviously also means release won't be this year.
At the moment I can't give you any more specifics as to when the next testing phase will happen, or what we've been working on, but we will let you know as soon as we are able to.
Beta testing is still open for applications, so if you have't applied already, then you can still do so over on the store page here https://store.steampowered.com/app/1551810/Block_N_Load_2/

notes.title: Closed Beta Testing news
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42508564/e0f8b87f602ada7ed715e15b8b45a09b4ab8388c.jpg[/img]

Greetings Blockheads!
We wanted to say a huge thank you to all of you that have participated in the Closed Beta Tests.
We will now take a longer pause from Beta Testing so that we can focus on fixing all the issues, improving performance, balancing etc, and take the necessary time to re-visit and go through all your feedback and bug reports.
So, we'll see you later in the year with more news and information!

[h3]Game modes[/h3]

[u][b]Domination[/b][/u]
Victory points are increased from 120 to 130
Team which owns at least two objectives now earns 1 point per 2 seconds (previously - 3 seconds)
[b][i]Control[/i][/b]
Point capture time decreased from 6 to 3 seconds
Victory points are increased from 124 to 130
Respawn time increased from 13 to 14 seconds
Losing team respawn time decreased from 7 to 6 seconds
Team which owns objective now earns 1 point per 2 seconds (previously - 3 seconds)
[b][i]Siege[/i][/b]
The catch time of the first point increased to 15 seconds
The catch time of the second point increased to 21 seconds

[h3]General changes[/h3]

[u][b]Events[/b][/u]
We have added a new event type - “[b][i]Regular Event[/i][/b]”. It starts for all players on the 1st of each month, and is themed around one random character. Complete event missions and unlock steps to receive rewards!

* First event step grants you access to hero for the event duration
* Last step unlocks that particular hero forever
* Already owned items are compensated with in game currency
* Event score progress now shown in victory screen for each event

[u][b]Shop[/b][/u]
New shop tab, where you can preview/buy packs containing cosmetics/boosters
Lots of new cosmetic content added/updated (both for shop and regular events)

[u][b]Hero customization screen[/b][/u]
* New UI
* F1 help info available on right click
* New item previews
* Charm preview/equipment

[u][b]Custom games” screen[/b][/u] 
* New UI
* New descriptions for game modes and maps
* Ability for host to change various game mode settings

[u][b]Сhat[/b][/u]
* New UI in main menu and in-game
* You can open player context menu by right clicking on player in chat or in in-game esc menu
* You can copy text, see player profile, add to friends, blacklist, report, mute or start private chat through this menu

[u][b]Praise/Report system[/b][/u]
* Right click on player in chat or in-game escape menu and select praise/report options
* Several praise/report choices are available

[u][b]Voice chat[/b][/u]
* Added team voice chat for custom and matchmaker games
* You can select between “Push to talk” and “Open mic” or disable voice chat completely in settings
* Added new sound slider for voice chat
* Added new hotkey for voice chat push to talk
* You can mute/unmute players through player context menu in game
* New in game UI to see who is talking/muted

[u][b]Combat improvements[/b][/u]
* Improvements/reworks to AoE visuals (more clarity, scaling with actual explosion radius). Still in progress for some effects.
* New UI/VFX for recently changed abilities/weapons
* Killcam camera does not jitter and positioned slightly further away
* New crosshair visuals that indicate hero-specific values (jetpack/weapon charge, toad shield health)
* New crosshair indicator for Lil Berr now shows if his hook will reach selected position
* Various small fixes/improvements to weapon logic/visuals
* Heal station/Bronerator reworked, both now can heal multiple targets simultaneously, Bronerator charge system reworked

[u][b]Game modes improvements[/b][/u]
* Resource drops now only spawn after build phase is over
* Flags in Activation game mode now emit large pillar of light
* New game feed notifications for Activation

[b][u]General UI improvements[/u][/b]
* Update UI for hero selection in game (H button)
* New resource drop indication UI
* F1 menu texts/icons updated
* Item preview (in customization and shop) improvements
* Rookie event UI now updates without game restart
* Fixed some visual glitches for non-16:9 monitors

[b][u]Sound improvements[/u][/b]
* Sound balance rework
* Improved footstep sounds
* Ambient sound fixes and improvements across all maps
* Fixes for third/first person character sounds and voice overs
* New announcer voice lines for main menu
* Reworked announcer logic for game modes

[u][b]Mission improvements[/b][/u]
* Support for more complex and interesting missions/achievements, some of which you will be able to see in new event missions

[b][u]General bug fixes[/u][/b]
* Various improvements and fixes to new outline system with distance color grading
* Animation fixes/improvements across all characters
* Fixed fire delay after sprint issues
* Fixed lingering effects not being removed on new round in SIEGE mode
* Fixed enemy hero/unit nameplates being sometimes visible through solid blocks
* Fixed enemy hero/unit outlines being sometimes invisible when they should be visible
* Fixed some graphic settings not being updated/reset on launch
* Water coastline visual glitches fixed
* Various crashes fixed

notes.title: Holiday Closed Beta updates!
notes.notes:
The day has come! 
Servers are now [b]live[/b] so jump in and destroy some enemy's cubes!

[b]Patch Notes[/b] :
[list]
[*]Digging Blocks no longer gives resources.
[*]Digging units no longer gives resources.
[*]Each character now has a certain amount of resources they can spend on units or cubes. Resources are gradually restored over time - this parameter is different for each character.
[*]Reloading of units is now decreased - to 1-2 seconds.
Increased the cost of all units and cubes.
[*]Most heroes no longer have double jumps.
[*]Only the Saboteur class has a double jump.
[*]Medics now have one, but a more powerful jump than before.
[*]Reworked Sniper's jet packs.
[*]Liz Tumbler: now the alt attack has no charge time and only consumes 1 ammo.
[*]Liz Tumbler’s Fibrillator amount of ammo increased to 90.
[*]Main attack ammo consumption increased to 30.
[*]Increased main attack damage.
[*]The slow now works from the alt attack.
[*]Made balance changes to the raycast weapons of the characters: most weapons now have increased spread to match their intended range.
[*]Changed the ballistics of Kamenev projectiles.
[*]Changed the range of Arnie's rockets.
[*]Added quick commands menu: you can build your own hotkey-bound radial menu in the game settings. By default, the radial command menu activates by pressing C or G keys.
[*]Now, during the respawn, you can look around the place of your death, as well as monitor the actions of allies or watch your detailed statistics in the match.
[*]Changed some environments. Lava doesnt kill instantly now.
[*]Increased damage to Professor Eliza’s units. Her main attack now can heal allies.
[*]Reduced Eliza Ray and Eliza Professor ability cooldowns, their effect is debuffed by the time and strength of the healing.
[*]Updated combat tutorial.
[*]Added [b]new game-mode: classic[/b]. It will be available in custom matches for the duration of the “holiday closed beta test”. Game-mode rules:
Every team has a cube-objective with 48000 HP. The main goal of teams is to deal as much damage as possible to the objective, and, if possible, destroy it in the allotted time
The team that destroys the enemy objective first - wins.
When the timer expires, the team with the most HP on the objective wins.
The mode has a build phase, during which the teams are separated from each other by an impenetrable barrier (you can't cross it or fire through it).
In the center of the maps of the game-mode, there is a platform where a special item appears every 120 seconds. When picked up, it gives 600 resources to each character in the team of the player who captured it.
The objective can be repaired by the shovel: each hit on an allied objective restores 50 health points.
Health points of the objective: 48000.
The health of the objective is divided into segments, when 25% of the health of the objective is destroyed, it is impossible to restore higher.
For example, if an enemy destroyed an objective by 24% of all health, then it can be restored fully, if destroyed by 26%, then the objective can only be restored up to 75% health.
The objective can be destroyed only by a shovel.
When an objective segment is destroyed, all killed heroes of the team whose segment is destroyed respawn at the base.

Other balance changes:
[*]Rocky Star’s ability now gives less healing (decrease from 200 to 150).
[*]Cubes of Medic and Engineer have less AOE resistance.
[*]The ability of Eliza Professor now has less effect and restores less health.
[*]The ability of Eliza Rey, Agent X now has a shorter duration and restores less
health.

[*]Acid cannon of Doc Eliza Dolally stains now spawn instantly, deals significantly less damage, and only lasts 15 seconds.
[*]Tesla charging time reduced from 5 to 4s.
[*]Turrets of Engineer, Medic and Sniper can’t no longer attack each other, EMP or bombs.
[*]Turrets of Engineers turrets target slower and attack at a slower speed.
[*]Fridge.Jr now applies significantly more armor (up to 1000), however, it now requires it to recover charges after applying armor.
[*]Fridge.Jr can now affect two heroes at once while having charges.
[*]Fridge.Jr now does not apply armor to any units except turrets (Engineer, Medic and Sniper).
[*]Radar has increased range.
[*]Increased the range of healing units.
[*]You can now re-press Liz Tumbler's ability key to detonate a projectile and apply a strong slow to nearby enemies, and a disable to surrounding enemy units.
[*]Reduced Anthony “Steam Toad” Frogg flamethrower base damage from 15 to 12.
[*]Reduced Engineer’s weapon shield health from 600 to 500.
[*]Increased EMP range from 600 to 700.
[*]The ability of Eliza “Chemie” White can now attach to allied characters and units by throwing a projectile at them.
[*]Healing from Eliza “Chemie” White's ability increased to 60 in 0,33 seconds.
[*]Reduced the health of all cubes.
[*]Mine damage was reduced from 700 to 600.
[*]Turret damage was reduced to 90.
[*]Decreased damage from mortar shells from 600 to 400.
[*]Added new sounds and visuals for gameplay effects.
[*]Optimized the projectile system in the game.
[/list]

Now you can add a player as a friend
Ability to invite players to a squad

Rectified turret`s targeting on just spawned character
Rectified  tutorial gates
Rectified kill count in tutorial
Rectified building on voxel in air
Rectified tutorial notifications
Rectified immortal units in tutorial
Rectified key bindings in settings
Rectified fire sound for automatic weapons
Rectified weapon reload sound
Rectified weapon reload animation
Rectified rocket launcher burst bug
Rectified matchmaker backfilling
Rectified AOE strength calculation bugs
Rectified disappearing build phase wall
Minimap now doesn’t show in tutorial
Changed logic for battle music in CONTROL and DOMINATION game modes
Improved Cogwheel`s hook logic
Removed additional timer on match start on dedicated server
Removed random bots names

Added squad members outline effect
Added timer on gates that show time to open spawn zone
Added sound notify for mortars
Added sound for falling voxels
Added local player hit 2D sound notification
Added mine explodes on enemy overlap only

Added a notification sound for enemy detection for bots in tutorial
Added trails for projectiles
13 heroes added to all players
